purpose: Pre-registered ETTh1 H336 validation screen for the train-time VPT and evaluation-time VAST-order MambaTS v11 candidate.
research_question: Does the public-MambaTS-style train-time transition-cost variable ordering improve ETTh1 H336 while retaining one Mamba scan and a direct AutoCon forecast path?
architecture: MambaTSv11 starts from local v3 shared patch scan. Each training sample receives a random channel permutation; detached pure prediction MSE updates every directed adjacent-edge cost and count. Evaluation derives a deterministic greedy minimum-cost path, applies it before the same scan, and restores original channels. AutoCon representation is directly connected to a zero-initialized forecast residual. The edge-cost mechanism follows public VPT; greedy decoding replaces its external ATSP solver, so this is not an official reproduction.
external_reference: Official MambaTS VPT/VAST implementation inspected at https://github.com/XiudingCai/MambaTS-pytorch, commit 3b6797d9bf5178a490e1bb3c3e9f4d223f2af51d.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory preflight. No test metric is produced, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass only licenses fresh-seed multi-dataset confirmation and matched prediction-only resource measurement. It does not license an official reproduction, paper claim, or held-out test release.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh1 SHA256 and multivariate dimensions
verify MambaTSv11 direct AutoCon forecast connection
verify detached pure-MSE VPT edge accounting and learned evaluation order
retain exactly one Mamba scan and output channel restoration

phases.name: v11_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTSv11 VPT graph with AutoCon lambda zero.

phases.name: v11_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTSv11 VPT graph with AutoCon lambda 0.001.

primary_contrasts: v11 active versus exact v11 lambda-zero control
comparison_contract.resource_gate: After an accuracy pass, benchmark prediction-only v11 and PatchTST under the exact B32/L96/C7/H336 config with 50 warm-up and 200 timed GPU forwards.

stopping_rules: Do not change VPT loss source, edge normalization, decoder, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
Stop v11 before multi-dataset expansion if active mean validation MSE is higher than PatchTST or if active is not lower than its exact null in at least two of three seed pairs.
No test release, resource claim, or hyperparameter adjustment is allowed if either condition fails.
